name: Hand Gripper Squeeze
steps: Sit or stand comfortably holding a hand gripper, therapeutic stress ball, or putty in the palm of your hand.
Wrap all four fingers securely around one handle and your thumb around the other.
Squeeze the gripper firmly and evenly until the handles touch or maximum safe resistance is achieved.
Hold the squeeze for 2 to 3 seconds, focusing on full forearm engagement.
Slowly open your hand over 2 seconds to release the tension with control.
coaching_cues: Distribute pressure evenly across all fingers, including your pinky and ring finger.
Do not allow the gripper to snap open; resist during the opening phase.
Keep your wrist straight and avoid bending it while squeezing.
